In my town, you get a hundred dollars every time someone lies to you.
But if you lie yourself, you lose five hundred.
That's why most people only make a few hundred dollars a day.
Dad says: Your drawing is beautiful. Plus a hundred for me.
Grandma says: I'm not tired at all. Plus a hundred.
My teacher says: The test will be super easy. Plus a hundred for the whole class.
So I came up with a plan.
I ask everyone questions they have to lie about.
Do you like my new haircut? Plus a hundred.
Do you like my cake? Plus a hundred.
Once I told Mom: I brushed my teeth. Minus five hundred.
Still, after one week I had ten thousand dollars.
There's only one person it never works on. My best friend.
He always tells the truth. With him, I don't get a single cent.
Until tonight.
He was standing at my door with a suitcase.
I asked: Is everything okay?
He smiled and said: Everything's fine. I'm not going anywhere.
And my account jumped. Plus a hundred.
And again. Plus a hundred.
My best friend just lied to me. Twice.
